applies_to.quote: The Trade Receivables Discounting System Platform Operators and Participants

answer.action: TReDS platform operators must comply with the new master directions, including capital requirements, onboarding rules, and reporting obligations.
answer.action_quote: These directions shall be termed as the Reserve Bank of India (Trade Receivables Discounting System) Directions, 2026 and shall be effective immediately.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall be termed as the Reserve Bank of India (Trade Receivables Discounting System) Directions, 2026 and shall be effective immediately.

comply_by.quote: Existing entities authorised to operate TReDS platform shall ensure that net-worth criterion is met latest by March 31, 2028.
comply_by.what: Meet the minimum net-worth criterion for existing TReDS platform entities.
